claimLedger.claim: IVF fertilises outside the body; typical stages stimulation–collection–lab–transfer; embryos cultured 2–6 days; cycle often 3–6 weeks; freeze surplus embryos; risks include OHSS, multiples, ectopic
claimLedger.sourceSection: HFEA · In vitro fertilisation (IVF) · Publication date listed 9 March 2016; page content fetched this session
claimLedger.limitations: UK regulator patient information; Indian clinic protocols and costs differ

claimLedger.claim: OHSS symptoms include swollen painful stomach, nausea/vomiting, shortness of breath, faintness, reduced urine; contact clinic; multiples and ectopic are key risks
claimLedger.sourceSection: HFEA · Risks of fertility treatment · Publication date listed 7 April 2016; page content fetched this session
claimLedger.limitations: UK clinic contact pathways; use local emergency services for severe breathing or chest symptoms in India
